feature.name: any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_factual_claim
feature.definition: OC_comments (other users): 1 if at least one comment, within the same comment, explicitly quotes specific OP wording and refutes that same OP factual claim; endorsement not required.
feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP text; use as context to identify OP factual claims) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly quotes (directly, or a close verbatim excerpt matching OP title/argument text) a specific factual claim made by the OP and (b) argues that this same factual claim is false or wrong. Quote and refutation must be in the same comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Merely mentioning the OP's topic, quoting a non-factual opinion/value claim, or quoting without refuting gives no match. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, in the argument or comments; do not use them as evidence (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed where relevant). Use current supplied text including marked edits; no initial snapshot is assumed. Return 0 if OC_comments is a valid empty list or no comment qualifies. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so that a quote match cannot be assessed (a positive match observed against available OP text still gives 1).

feature.name: any_comment_engages_op_cited_examples_or_premises
feature.definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment explicitly engages (addresses, rebuts, or builds on) a specific example or premise cited in the OP's title/argument text.
feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP's text) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly engages with a specific example or premise actually stated in the OP's title or argument (e.g. names, quotes, paraphrases and then addresses, rebuts, or builds on that particular example or premise). Generic replies that only address the overall topic or the conclusion without referring to a specific OP example/premise return 0 for that comment. Agreement or disagreement both count if explicit engagement is present; endorsement is not required. Use OP text only to identify targets. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Use supplied current text (including marked edits) apart from that exclusion; no chronology is inferred from list order. Return 0 if OC_comments is a valid empty list; return null if OC_comments or the OP text is missing or malformed. Output one scalar 0/1.

feature.name: any_comment_asserts_propositional_falsity
feature.definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment asserts that an OP proposition or claim is factually or logically false/incorrect.
feature.spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it) and the OP title and argument as context for identifying the OP's claims. Return 1 if at least one comment asserts that a proposition or claim made by the OP (in title or argument) is false, incorrect or logically unsound, i.e. disputes its truth rather than describing consequences. Quoted material counts only if the commenter adopts it. Comments that only add harms, offer opinions, or agree do not count. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, in any field; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting. Use current supplied text; list order carries no meaning. Return 0 if the comment list is valid (including empty) and no comment qualifies. Return null if OC_comments is missing/malformed, or if OP title and argument are both missing. Output a single 0/1 per row.

feature.name: any_comment_identifies_op_internal_contradiction
feature.definition: Other-user comments: 1 if at least one comment identifies a logical contradiction or inconsistency within the OP's own stated premises (title/argument).
feature.spec: Read title, argument and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment argues that the OP's own stated premises (as written in title/argument) contradict each other or are mutually inconsistent, i.e. a logical contradiction internal to the OP's position. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so (including comments that only dispute premises using outside facts, or only disagree). Return 0 for a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing/malformed or if title and argument are both missing. Use current supplied text, including marked edits. Ignore and never use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, wherever they appear; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. List order carries no meaning. The same comment may also cite external evidence; this does not affect the value.

feature.name: any_comment_acknowledges_op_premise_before_divergence
feature.definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment explicitly acknowledges the validity of the OP's premise (initial premise) and then introduces divergence/disagreement within the same comment.
feature.spec: Read title, argument (OP's view) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment, within that same comment, first explicitly acknowledges that the OP's initial premise (a starting premise/claim of the OP's view, identified from title and argument) is valid, correct or reasonable (e.g. concedes a point as right), and afterwards introduces a point of divergence, disagreement or counter-argument. Both parts must be in the same comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Vague politeness, mere topical engagement, or acknowledging only that the OP has feelings or tried, without conceding validity of the premise, does not count. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so that the OP premise cannot be identified. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; do not use them as evidence of the OP premise or anything else. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; no initial snapshot is inferred, and list order is not chronology.

feature.name: any_comment_direct_counterargument

feature.spec: Read title, argument and OC_comments (a JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment directly counterargues the OP's view: it explicitly presents reasoning, evidence or examples against the OP's main view (title/argument) or a specific OP claim. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does so (e.g., only agreement, clarifying questions, off-topic remarks, jokes, moderator/bot notices, or tangents that do not argue against the OP's view). An empty valid list returns 0. If OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP title and argument are both missing so the target view cannot be identified, return null. Quoted material counts only when the commenter uses it to argue against the OP. Do not use any OP view-change or delta-award announcement, post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred as evidence, even if inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; do not infer timing or initial snapshots. Output a single 0/1 or null.

Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP title and argument are both missing such that the OP's view cannot be identified. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; no timing is inferred.

Quotations of others' experience count only if the commenter adopts them as relevant to the contrast. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list.
